Compatibility with Existing Infrastructure The existing ICU boom infrastructure was originally installed using Stryker tandem mounting plates and support structures. These systems have been engineered, validated, and load-rated for the current installation as well as future Stryker boom replacements. Per VASNHCS, selecting an alternative manufacturer would require an engineering evaluation to determine compatibility with the existing structural support system and mounting hardware. Preventive maintenance procedures, troubleshooting workflows, and service protocols are already established around this platform as well as established maintenance processes. Compatibility with Existing Infrastructure The existing ICU boom infrastructure was originally installed using Stryker tandem mounting plates and support structures.
